description: Named rule subsets of review_rules.json. A preset only selects rules; severities, the verdict policy and the untrusted-data framing stay exactly as the rubric defines them. Pick one with --preset on review, packet, check and init.

full.description: All seventeen rules. The coverage claim; also the noisiest (Stage 1: precision 0.17 on the toy suite).

focused.description: The five rules the hardening plan marks Keep: at least one true positive and precision >= 0.5 in the Stage 1 live run (R1, R7, R14, R16, R17). Measured on 13 toy cases, not the Stage 2 corpus: a starting point, not a calibrated gate.

security.description: R7 only: validation, secrets, injection. Cheapest pass, and the one rule that caught the most in Stage 1 (3 true, 1 false).
